# Vendored Deslop Web UI package

This directory contains `@deslop/web-ui` 0.1.0 from
[`mishanaer/deslop`](https://github.com/mishanaer/deslop) at commit
`910c40ca9c81cd18f768b610cdfc3776b6125539`.

The package was built from that exact commit with `pnpm build:lib`. Its source,
agent catalog, setup CLI, and generated distribution are preserved unchanged.
The repository-only `@deslop/primitives` `link:` dev dependency was removed
from the consumer manifest because npm cannot resolve pnpm workspace links.
